SELECT E.EVT_ID AS evtId, E.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, E.TITLE AS title, E.EVT_TYPE AS evtType, TC.CODE_NM AS evtTypeNm, E.SEVERITY AS severity, VC.CODE_NM AS severityNm, E.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, E.CHARGER_ID AS chargerId, TO_CHAR(E.OCCR_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS occrDt FROM OPS_EVENT E LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON E.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'EVENT_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = E.STATUS LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'EVENT_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = E.EVT_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE VC ON VC.CODE_GRP = 'EVENT_SEVERITY' AND VC.CODE_ID = E.SEVERITY WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY E.EVT_ID DESC OFFSET #{firstIndex} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{recordCountPerPage} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OPS_EVENT E WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT E.EVT_ID AS evtId, E.SYS_ID AS sysId, S.SYS_NM AS sysNm, E.TITLE AS title, E.EVT_TYPE AS evtType, TC.CODE_NM AS evtTypeNm, E.SEVERITY AS severity, VC.CODE_NM AS severityNm, E.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, TO_CHAR(E.OCCR_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS occrDt, E.CONTENT AS content, E.ACTION AS action, E.CHARGER_ID AS chargerId, E.LINKED_INC_ID AS linkedIncId, TO_CHAR(E.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS regDt FROM OPS_EVENT E LEFT JOIN OPS_SYSTEM S ON E.SYS_ID = S.SYS_ID LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'EVENT_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = E.STATUS LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE TC ON TC.CODE_GRP = 'EVENT_TYPE' AND TC.CODE_ID = E.EVT_TYPE LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE VC ON VC.CODE_GRP = 'EVENT_SEVERITY' AND VC.CODE_ID = E.SEVERITY WHERE E.EVT_ID = #{evtId}

SELECT H.HIS_ID AS hisId, H.EVT_ID AS evtId, H.STATUS AS status, SC.CODE_NM AS statusNm, H.CONTENT AS content, H.PROC_ID AS procId, TO_CHAR(H.PROC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS procDt FROM OPS_EVENT_HIS H LEFT JOIN OPS_CODE SC ON SC.CODE_GRP = 'EVENT_STATUS' AND SC.CODE_ID = H.STATUS WHERE H.EVT_ID = #{evtId} ORDER BY H.HIS_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OPS_EVENT (SYS_ID, TITLE, EVT_TYPE, SEVERITY, STATUS, OCCR_DT, CONTENT, ACTION, CHARGER_ID, LINKED_INC_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{sysId}, #{title}, #{evtType}, #{severity}, #{status}, TO_TIMESTAMP(REPLACE(#{occrDt}, 'T', ' '), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{content}, #{action}, #{chargerId}, #{linkedIncId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO OPS_EVENT_HIS (EVT_ID, STATUS, CONTENT, PROC_ID, PROC_DT) VALUES (#{evtId}, #{status}, #{content}, #{procId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
